title: Downtown Riverfront KING Bedroom
description:
Riverfront getaway apartment ideal for access downtown for a weekend for 2-4 people. Walk or Uber to the best nightlife and live music, or explore the restaurants of Germantown. The Titans stadium sits just across the river to the south, and “hipster” east-Nashville is in the same direction. The apartment is a cozy place with one king bed in the bedroom and a blow-up bed in the living room, plus a balcony that overlooks the river and modern kitchen.
